$Comment: What sitting down to the feast pays, once a year. Martha's Golden Plate with the year on it is not
here: it is the quest's own first Claim row, whose StackNameArg @run names it for the year's run.
The first roll always pays Harvest Coins, festival tokens and the feast's leftovers: two meat pies to
take home, and the pumpkin pie, roast vegetable and cooked wildmeat that the three supper deliveries
(Supper_Tomas, Supper_Elsie and Supper_Bram) ask the player to take to the villagers. Its Cue plays
(FeedbackMoments/SeasonsOfOrbis/), the feast's celebration, as the pay is collected; this table pays
only The Feast, once a year, so the cue never repeats. The second roll is a chance on top; Chance is
a percent from 0 to 100. Favor rides the quest's own Rewards.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Feast_Pay
